moments.title: Premier League Returns
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off this weekend, with Arsenal v Coventry City on Friday, and Hull City v Manchester United among Saturday's fixtures.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: The whistle blows! Premier League 2026/27 season is officially underway this weekend. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Weekend fixtures spotlight
angles.copy: Football is back! Your weekend plans are sorted with Premier League action kicking off. Hull City vs Man Utd, Arsenal vs Coventry... get ready!

moments.title: EFL Action: Cardiff vs Wrexham
moments.blurb: Cardiff City host newly promoted Wrexham in an EFL fixture tonight, closing out the opening weekend of the EFL season.

angles.name: Derby Day anticipation
angles.copy: Tonight's the night! Cardiff City take on Wrexham in a huge EFL clash. Who's bringing home the points in this Welsh derby?

angles.name: Wrexham's big test
angles.copy: Wrexham face a big test tonight against Cardiff City in the EFL. Can the Red Dragons upset the odds?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating soul, hip hop, house, afro, electronica, and jazz, kicks off in Dorset from August 20-23. The festival is officially sold out.

angles.name: Festival vibes start
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is almost here! Get ready for four days of incredible music and good vibes in Dorset, starting Thursday. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Sold out success
angles.copy: It's a sell-out! We Out Here Festival is ready to bring the best in soul, jazz & dance to Dorset this weekend. Festival season is in full swing!

moments.title: Green Man Festival
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, nestled in the Brecon Beacons, Wales, runs from August 20-23, offering a blend of music, arts, and family-friendly activities. The festival is sold out.

angles.name: Welsh festival excitement
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is back this Thursday! The Brecon Beacons will be buzzing with music, arts, and good times. Who's heading to Wales for the weekend?

angles.name: Sold out Welsh gem
angles.copy: Another sold-out year for Green Man! Starting Thursday, it's set to be an incredible weekend in the heart of the Brecon Beacons. Enjoy the magic, Wales!

moments.title: Trentham Live Festival
moments.blurb: Trentham Live, a four-day music festival, takes place at The Trentham Estate in Staffordshire from August 20-23.

angles.name: Staffordshire's big gig
angles.copy: Trentham Live kicks off Thursday! Four days of fantastic music at The Trentham Estate. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Live music in the Midlands
angles.copy: Staffordshire, get ready! Trentham Live is bringing the noise this weekend. Perfect for a summer festival experience.

moments.title: UK No.1 Single: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold the top spot on the UK Official Singles Chart (August 14-19, 2026) with 'REIN ME IN'.

angles.name: Chart topper celebration
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are holding strong at UK No.1 with 'REIN ME IN'. What a track!

angles.name: Weekend soundtrack
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack just got confirmed: 'REIN ME IN' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is still the UK's No.1! Tune in and turn it up.

moments.title: Julian Casablancas' 48th Birthday
moments.blurb: Julian Casablancas, frontman of The Strokes, turns 48 on August 23rd. He was born in 1978.

angles.name: Strokes legend birthday
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to The Strokes' iconic frontman, Julian Casablancas! Still making 'Is This It' sound fresh.

angles.name: Indie icon celebration
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 48th Birthday to Julian Casablancas! What's your favourite Strokes track?

moments.title: Shaun Ryder's 64th Birthday
moments.blurb: Shaun Ryder, the legendary frontman of Happy Mondays and Black Grape, turns 64 on August 23rd. He was born in 1962.

angles.name: Madchester icon birthday
angles.copy: Get your baggy trousers on! Happy 64th Birthday to the one and only Shaun Ryder of Happy Mondays and Black Grape fame. A true legend!

angles.name: Happy Mondays celebration
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 64th Birthday to the inimitable Shaun Ryder! What's your favourite Happy Mondays anthem?

moments.title: Rick Springfield's 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: Australian pop-rock icon Rick Springfield, known for 'Jessie's Girl', turns 77 on August 23rd. He was born in 1949.

angles.name: 80s pop-rock hero
angles.copy: Don't wish you had 'Jessie's Girl' – wish Rick Springfield a very Happy 77th Birthday! A true 80s icon.

angles.name: Classic hitmaker
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the legendary Rick Springfield! Still rockin' after all these years. What's your favourite hit from him?

moments.title: Bobby G's 73rd Birthday
moments.blurb: Bobby G, member of the Eurovision-winning group Bucks Fizz, turns 73 on August 23rd. He was born in 1953.

angles.name: Eurovision star birthday
angles.copy: Making your mind up for a birthday wish? Happy 73rd Birthday to Bobby G from the iconic Bucks Fizz!

angles.name: Pop legend celebration
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 73rd Birthday to Bobby G! A true pop legend who brought us some unforgettable hits.

moments.title: Edwyn Collins' 67th Birthday
moments.blurb: Scottish singer-songwriter Edwyn Collins, known for his work with Orange Juice and solo hit 'A Girl Like You', turns 67 on August 23rd. He was born in 1959.

angles.name: Indie icon's special day
angles.copy: A very Happy 67th Birthday to the brilliant Edwyn Collins! From Orange Juice to solo success, a true music innovator.

angles.name: Girl Like You hitmaker
angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 67th to Edwyn Collins! The voice behind 'A Girl Like You' and so many more fantastic tracks. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Next Week
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals take place next week, from August 27-30, marking the UK's August Bank Holiday weekend with a massive lineup.

angles.name: Bank Holiday festival buzz
angles.copy: Less than a week to go until Reading & Leeds! Who's ready for the biggest Bank Holiday weekend festival in the UK?

angles.name: Lineup anticipation
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Reading & Leeds! Get ready for a huge weekend of music across both sites. What acts are you most excited for?

moments.title: Victorious Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: Victorious Festival, located in Portsmouth, is set for the August Bank Holiday weekend, running from August 28-30.

angles.name: Portsmouth festival buzz
angles.copy: Victorious Festival is just around the corner! Get ready for an amazing Bank Holiday weekend by the sea in Portsmouth.

angles.name: Last chance for tickets
angles.copy: Planning your Bank Holiday? Victorious Festival is happening next weekend in Portsmouth! Don't miss out on the fun.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weather Outlook
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday weekend (August 29-31, 2026) is approaching, with typical mild to warm UK weather expected, including sunny spells and a chance of showers.

angles.name: Bank Holiday forecast check
angles.copy: The August Bank Holiday is just two weeks away! Time to start planning those long weekend activities. What's the weather looking like for you?

angles.name: Making the most of the long weekend
angles.copy: Sun or showers, we're ready for the August Bank Holiday! How are you planning to make the most of the extra long weekend?
